semantics.REFUTED: idea stays dead: mechanism-rejected, or worse than its era champion by >= the MDE at time of test
semantics.UNRESOLVED: |delta| below the MDE (the verdict was a coin flip), or magnitude unrecoverable from disk
semantics.CONFIRMED: idea was actually distinguishably better — rejection overturned

mde_definition: 2.8016 * sigma_regime / sqrt(n_at_test); sigma measured on the current frozen v7 holdout pairs (within 0.0218, cross 0.0722, cross-region bucket 0.0770) — an approximation when applied to older eras (flagged per row)
source_note: published ledger (gen_final_model.py REJECTED list) contains 32 entries; the v8 brief said 33 — no 33rd entry exists in the generator or the published HTML
